name: Hubei Radio & Television Information Network Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei Radio & Television Information Network Co., Ltd. plans, designs, develops, constructs, manages, and operates radio and television information network in China. The company provides live channels, Crocodile TV, OTT applications, broadband cable TV, TV lottery, mobile network service, and other products. It also offers private data network, online rental, e-government, information integration, smart city, and 5G demonstration services. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
